scene_description: Library shelf of reference books ending at a metal bookend. The green A-F volume leans on the blue A-K volume. The blue L-Z and a black Bompiani volume lie flat, spines to the back. Two Bompiani volumes stand by the bookend. Book sizes are for books lying flat; front is the open face of the shelf.

targets.name: blue A-K dictionary
targets.description: Blue 'dictionnaire des Littératures' A-K volume standing at the far left end of the shelf, with the green A-F volume leaning on it.
nearby_obstacles: Left end of the shelf
Green A-F volume leaning on its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Left side is against the shelf end and the leaning green book presses on its right.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the leaning green A-F volume upright so it no longer rests on this book.

targets.name: green A-F dictionary
targets.description: Green 'Dictionnaire universel des littératures' A-F volume leaning left against the blue A-K volume.
nearby_obstacles: Blue A-K volume supporting it
Green G-O volume at its lower right
targets.clearance_notes: Spine and top are exposed, but it is tilted and may fall when its neighbors move.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the volume upright with its spine facing out.

targets.name: green G-O dictionary
targets.description: Green 'Dictionnaire universel des littératures' G-O volume standing to the right of the leaning A-F volume.
nearby_obstacles: Green P-Z volume touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Right side is packed; the upper left side is open where the A-F volume leans away.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: green P-Z dictionary
targets.description: Green 'Dictionnaire universel des littératures' P-Z volume standing between the green G-O volume and the beige index.
nearby_obstacles: Green G-O volume touching its left side
Beige index touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Packed between books on both sides, with almost no room above it.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: beige index
targets.description: Thin beige 'Index des oeuvres' volume standing between the green P-Z volume and an upright green Bompiani volume.
nearby_obstacles: Green P-Z volume touching its left side
Green Bompiani volume touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Only 3 cm thick and packed between books, with almost no room above it.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the index approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: left green Bompiani volume
targets.description: Small green 'Dizionario Bompiani' volume standing upright between the beige index and the flat stack of books.
nearby_obstacles: Beige index touching its left side
Flat stack of books at its lower right
targets.clearance_notes: Left side is packed, but its upper right side is open above the low flat stack.

targets.name: blue L-Z dictionary
targets.description: Blue 'dictionnaire des Littératures' L-Z volume lying flat in the middle of the shelf under a black Bompiani volume, spine facing the back.
targets.orientation: lying flat, spine facing the back
nearby_obstacles: Black Bompiani volume lying on top of it
targets.clearance_notes: Front page edges are exposed; the top is covered and the spine is hidden.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the black Bompiani volume off the blue book.
Stand the blue book upright with its spine facing out, next to the A-K volume.

targets.other_notes: Spine faces the back, so the title can't be read.

targets.orientation: lying flat, spine facing the back
nearby_obstacles: Blue L-Z volume underneath it
targets.clearance_notes: Top and front page edges are exposed; the spine is hidden.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the volume upright with its spine facing out, beside the other Bompiani volumes.

targets.other_notes: Spine faces the back, so the title can't be read.

targets.name: right green Bompiani volume

targets.orientation: upright, angled slightly toward the front-left
nearby_obstacles: Black Bompiani volume touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Left side is open above the flat stack; spine and top are exposed.

nearby_obstacles: Green Bompiani volume touching its left side
Bookend touching its right side

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: bookend
targets.description: Black metal bookend at the right end of the shelf, holding up the two upright Bompiani volumes.
nearby_obstacles: Black Bompiani volume leaning on its left side
targets.clearance_notes: Top edge and right side are open.

source: Staged permutation of S0029 and S0031, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
